name: markdown-disallowed-errors
body: Each of these in a body = error with file/line and guidance: images (use image fields), tables, blockquotes, fenced/indented code (except the section-frontmatter fence), horizontal rules, raw HTML, angle-bracket autolinks, GFM/other extensions (strikethrough, highlight, sup/sub, emoji shortcodes), `####`+ headings, lists nested deeper than one level.
